title: Ignatius Rocketfrock and the Level That Was Edited On Purpose

entities.notes: Effective level start. The doorway opens, Ignatius walks out behind its actorFront half-door, and it closes behind him.
Tutorial mailbox. Its letter, thought, trigger distance, and timings are stored on this mailbox entity; more mailboxes may be added to the same level.
entities.letterTitle: A Letter from Your Humble Editor
entities.letterText:
Dear Ignatius,

I hope this letter finds you well, and with most of your limbs still attached. I look forward to receiving the first chapter of your travel book shortly. I have even come up with a great title: “Ignatius Rocketfrock and the Introductory Cave of Training.” Please proceed boldly!

Sincerely,
Your humble editor,
Wilfred of Bittervine
entities.thoughtText: How kind of him! I hope I can make him proud. This cave doesn’t look quite like it did in the brochures, but I’m sure it will be fine.

entities.notes: First runtime Skeleton Guard patrol. It rushes Ignatius inside its patrol area and uses a rapid close-range sword combo.
Mirrored level exit. Opens when Ignatius approaches, walks him through, then loads destinationLevel. Missing destinations fall back to the current level.

note: Level placements are data. Revision 097 makes the Skeleton Guard rush intruders inside its patrol area and chain rapid close-range sword attacks.
